people.imagined: Dusk at the gate of the hall on the hill above the market. A caravan has just come in whole and he stands in the doorway as he always does, a little to one side so the drivers can pass, the staff upright beside him. Someone has asked him about the cage and he has not answered; he is only looking at them.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a doorway, he stands square and still with a staff upright at his right hand, a little to one side so others can pass, as if the door were his to hold; he is only looking at the viewer. Face: a broad, plain, weather-brown face with a nose clearly broken and set a little to the left, a flat bump across the bridge; a heavy jaw with short black stubble, thick straight brows, small deep-set brown eyes with crow's-feet, a few grey hairs only at the temples. Hair: black, cut short, tied in a stubby knot at the crown with a silver clasp and a strip of grey silk. Body: broad, thick through the shoulders and neck, solid as a gatepost, slightly stooped from decades of leaning into wind. Clothing: the hall head's richest robes: layered grey silk with three crossed collars trimmed in wolf fur, silver running wolves embroidered along the borders, a full grey wolf mantle over both shoulders with a pale ruff and a silver wolf-head clasp; a silk sash with a jade pendant; a bone whistle on a cord at his neck. Hands and objects: both hands rest on a long staff of dark wood worn pale and glossy by the grip, the right over the left, the knuckles scarred. Power: a deep, steady aura of green Wood qi stirs the fur of his mantle, with faint green motes drifting up like pine needles. Background: a wooden doorframe with dusk-blue pines behind and a lit lantern low in the distance, in violet mist. Light: warm amber from the upper left on the face, cold blue spirit-light dusk behind, a silver rim along the fur. Expression: patient, level, unreadable, a man who keeps a thing to himself.

people.imagined: The counting-house at Tùng Hạ Thị in winter, late. He has just finished paying out a driver's leg and writing it down as something else, and a young warden has walked in. He laughs to cover it and the bell on his belt rings; for a moment the laugh is not quite his usual one.
people.subject: The moment: in a lamplit counting-room in winter, late, he looks up from a desk mid-laugh, shoulders shaking, a little too bright, having just covered a payment with a laugh when a young warden walked in. Face: a round, ruddy, stout face with fat cheeks lifting into deep laugh-lines, a short squashed nose, small bright black eyes nearly closed by the laugh, a gap between his two front teeth, a thin drooping moustache of grey and black. Hair: thick grey-black, oiled, combed flat under a small round merchant's cap of dark blue silk with a silver wolf-head clasp. Body: short, stout and barrel-chested, leaning back on a low stool. Clothing: an elder's grey silk robe in a merchant's cut, dark blue-grey padded silk with a high stand collar and frogged toggles of knotted silk cord, silver running wolves embroidered along the borders, a collar trimmed with grey wolf fur and a short wolf-fur strip over the left shoulder; a thick grey silk scarf at the throat. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a small round brass camel bell the size of an apple, swinging by its strap mid-ring; the left rests on a wooden abacus on the desk. Power: a faint yellow-ochre shimmer of Earth and silver-grey Metal motes drifts above the abacus beads. Background: a shelf of cloth-wrapped bundles and a hanging oil lamp, in warm haze. Light: warm yellow lamplight from the upper left, a little reddish, with a soft glow on the bell. Expression: jolly on the surface, and, if you look, tired under it.

people.imagined: A cold clear morning in the shooting yard. She has just loosed an arrow and is not watching it; her eagle has already gone after it and she is looking at the young wardens down the line, counting who flinched. The three wolf ears swing on her belt.
people.subject: The moment: in a frosty shooting yard on a cold clear morning, she has just loosed an arrow and is not watching it; she looks straight at the viewer, mouth set, counting who flinched. Face: a small, thin, deeply weathered face, brown as old leather, lines etched like cracked mud, a hooked narrow nose, sunken cheeks, pale grey-green eyes, narrow and unblinking, a thin straight mouth. Hair: iron grey, pulled back tight into a single braid wound round the head, with two bone pins and a small silver wolf-head ornament. Body: small, wiry, straight-backed, sharp at the shoulder. Clothing: an elder's long grey silk robe with three crossed collars, silver running wolves along the borders, a full dark grey-black wolf mantle with the pelt's snarling-head flap on one shoulder and a silver wolf-head clasp; a silk sash and a leather wrist guard on the left forearm. Hands and objects: a heavy horn-and-yew recurve bow held low in her left hand; on her left shoulder a grey-backed northern eagle with a pale head, a hood pushed back, talons on a leather pad; at her belt a cord with three dried grey wolf ears. Power: a green Wood aura runs along the bowstave and trails after the vanished arrow in pale green motes. Background: straw targets and pale pines in frost and silver mist. Light: cold white morning spirit-light from the upper left, glinting on the eagle's eye, a thin rim light. Expression: a flat, unblinking pale grey-green stare, the thin mouth set, cold and patient as a hunter.

people.imagined: The mule lines at night, a lantern on a hook. One mule is lame and he has her foreleg in his lap; she has put her head on his shoulder. He glances up when someone enters, one hand still on the hock.
people.subject: The moment: in the mule lines at night, he crouches with a lame mule's head resting against his shoulder, her foreleg in his lap, and glances up when someone enters, one hand still on the hock. Face: a long calm face with deep lines either side of the mouth, a prominent chin, a long straight nose, heavy-lidded warm brown eyes, skin tanned to dark tea, a short grey-flecked beard. Hair: grizzled black, shaggy, held back with a leather thong and a plain silver pin. Body: lean, long-armed, kneeling easily. Clothing: an inner warden's grey silk robe with silver running-wolf borders, the crossed collars trimmed with wolf fur and a wolf-fur half-cape over the left shoulder, the sleeves pushed to the elbow; his hem and knees stained with salve and hay, which the stable work calls for, but kept clean. Hands and objects: on his right wrist a pale, ropy whip scar like a bracelet, wound all the way round; at his neck on a cord a small iron bell-clapper, dull and unpolished; his left hand holds a small clay pot of salve; beside him the long brown face of a mule with white around her eyes, ears turned toward him. Power: a gentle green glow of Wood qi gathers in his palm over the hock and fades into the mule's coat in soft motes. Background: a row of mules in stalls behind him with ears turned toward the lantern, a bale of hay and a hoof-pick hung on a nail, in warm shadowy mist. Light: a single golden lantern from the upper left, with a soft glow and gentle rim light on the mule's brow. Expression: soft, patient, unhurried.

people.imagined: The trailhead of the Bạch Lang road in first light. He has come back from the night patrol and is rolling his stiff arm at the shoulder, testing it; one hand touches the wolf-tooth charm. He has seen something on the road and has not yet decided to tell.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a pine road at first light, back from the night patrol, he rolls his left shoulder to test a healed arm, one hand touching the wolf-tooth charm, and stares past the viewer down the road, having seen something he has not yet decided to tell. Face: a lean hard tanned face with a short black beard and a deep old claw scar cutting down the right cheek, three pale parallel lines; a nose flared at the nostril, black brows drawn low, dark eyes tired and hot. Hair: black, wild, tied in a short tail with a strip of silver-grey silk. Body: tall, lean, hard-muscled, the left arm held a little stiff and bent. Clothing: an inner warden's grey silk robe with silver running wolves along the borders, a wolf-fur half-cape over the left shoulder, crossed collars trimmed with fur, the left sleeve pushed up to show the forearm where a crooked bone has knit under the skin; leather bracers. Hands and objects: a single large wolf tooth, yellow-white and the length of a finger, on a plaited silver-grey cord at his chest, held between his right finger and thumb; a short bow across his back. Power: a faint green Wood glow and pale motes cling to the healed arm like threads. Background: a grey fence of old pine trunks lining a pale road in blue mist, a broken wagon wheel leaning at the verge, a pair of crows watching from a bough. Light: pale gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left with a silver rim. Expression: grim, watchful, ready to be angry.

people.imagined: Crouched on the Bạch Lang road at dusk with her face almost against the frozen needles, smelling a track. She has just found it and is deciding what to say about it. She has sent a girl up here alone before and does not think about that.
people.subject: The moment: crouching low on the pine road at dusk with her face almost against the frozen needles, nostrils flared, she smells a track and looks up sideways at the viewer, deciding what to say about it. Face: her left ear is plainly missing its lobe, a clean healed notch with a pale scar, large and visible beneath the hair, while the right ear is whole; a narrow face, hollow cheeks, a long thin nose with a pinched tip, grey-brown skin lined like bark, pale flat eyes almost yellow, thin bloodless lips. Hair: dull grey, cut short and uneven at the nape, a loose wolf-tail tied through one lock with a bone bead. Body: spare, folded low on her heels, knees at her chest. Clothing: an inner warden's grey silk robe with silver running-wolf borders and a wolf-fur half-cape over the left shoulder, a leather hood pushed back, fingerless grey gloves, dark silk trousers tucked into fur boots; frost clings to the shoulders. Hands and objects: her bare right fingers press flat on a patch of frost and brown needles where a pale pawprint shows; a bone whistle on a cord at her chest. Power: a cool green wisp of Wood qi curls from her fingertips into the track, and a faint cloud of breath hangs before her lips. Background: dark pine trunks and a thread of fog in the dusk. Light: dim blue spirit-light from the upper left with a rim of cold white on her cheek. Expression: still, flat, vengeful, almost pleased.

people.imagined: Walking the night patrol after counting fees all day; he stops under a milestone lantern to check the abacus in his sleeve against the road he just walked. A sound from the dark makes him tuck it away fast, guilty, though he is only counting.
people.subject: The moment: on night patrol beside a milestone lantern, he has just pulled a small abacus half out of his sleeve to check the road he walked, and looks round startled at a sound in the dark, as if caught, though he is only counting. Face: a thin, sharp-featured young face with a narrow nose, high forehead, long upper lip and quick, close-set dark eyes; a pencil-thin moustache that does not quite grow; ink-and-chalk smudges on his cheek. Hair: black, parted at the side, neat and a little oiled, the knot at the crown held with a bone pin. Body: slim, quick, a little hunched. Clothing: an inner warden's grey silk robe, silver running wolves along its borders, a wolf-fur half-cape worn tidy on the left shoulder, a clean white inner collar showing at the neck, a silk sash with a bone whistle; pale chalk dust whitening the toes of his boots. Hands and objects: a small bone abacus with eight rows of pale glossy beads half out of the left sleeve; the right hand holds a staff. Power: a few silver-grey Metal motes tick like sparks above the beads, with a faint green glow in the shadows of the fur. Background: night pines and a pale road, a milestone with a lantern glowing at its side, wagon ruts in the frozen mud, a line of mules with bells a dim shape down the road, in mist. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left with a soft glow and cold blue night behind. Expression: shifty, clever, trying to look dull.

people.imagined: The shooting yard, lunch hour. He cannot sit through the meal; he has gone back out to stand at the line, jaw working, bowstring pulled to his ear, looking for a running target that is not there. The four wolf tails at his belt swing.
people.subject: The moment: at a shooting line in the lunch hour, he stands with the bow drawn to his cheek and turns his head to glare at the viewer, restless and hungry for a running target that is not there. Face: two deep, raw bowstring grooves across the first two fingers of his drawing hand held near his cheek, red and callused; a young, narrow, freckled face, a jutting jaw, thick black brows knitted together, a sharp nose, dark eyes too bright, a thin sneer. Hair: black, cropped and uneven, a stiff tuft at the front. Body: wiry, tense, rising a little on his toes. Clothing: an outer warden's grey silk robe with a clean strip of wolf fur at the collar, silver running wolves along the borders, wide sleeves bound back at the wrists, a leather bracer on the left forearm; at his belt four wolf-tail tassels, grey, brown and black, hanging in a row. Hands and objects: a short, self-strung bow of pale yew, drawn; an arrow nocked with red-dyed fletching. Power: a faint green Wood shimmer gathers on the arrowhead. Background: at the far end of the yard a row of straw targets stuck with arrows, a rack of unstrung bows and a high plank fence with pine tops above it, in pale mist. Light: bright hard noon spirit-light from the upper left with a silver rim along his jaw. Expression: a hot, hungry glare with jaw working and brows low, nostrils flared, restless for the target.

people.imagined: Alone on the road at night, a girl who has been sent to find sign. She has stopped to lick her cracked lips and is holding the too-big wolf's-tooth necklace out from her chest, uncertain whether to be afraid. She has found something.
people.subject: The moment: alone on a frozen path at night, sent to find sign, she holds out an oversized wolf's-tooth necklace between two fingers and looks to the side, lips parted, unsure whether to be afraid; she has found something. Face: a thin small face with chapped, split lips plainly red and cracked, a bead of dark red where the upper lip has split again, wind-reddened cheeks and a raw nose-tip, large dark eyes wide with alertness, thin straight brows, a small scab on her chin, eyelashes frosted white at the tips. Hair: black, in two short uneven braids tied with silver-grey silk cord. Body: slight, a head shorter than the others, shoulders hunched in a robe too big. Clothing: an outer warden's grey silk robe with a narrow wolf-fur strip at the collar and silver running wolves along its borders, sleeves turned back twice, a knitted grey scarf with a bone whistle tucked inside, grey wool mittens. Hands and objects: a huge wolf's-tooth, yellow-white and thick as her thumb, on a loose cord hanging low on her chest; a short child's bow across her back with its string wrapped in a rag, a small pouch of dried meat at her hip. Power: a faint pale green mote of Wood qi trembles at the tooth, hardly there. Background: black pines and a thin moon, a faint line of grey tracks crossing the snow between the trunks, in silver mist. Light: pale blue moon and starlight from the upper left, the white of the tooth and the frost on her lashes the brightest things in the picture. Expression: brave and frightened at once.

people.imagined: Midnight on the Tùng Hạ road. He is chatting away to the dark, as he does, and has just turned to the viewer to include them in the conversation, mid-sentence, grinning.
people.subject: The moment: walking the Tùng Hạ road at midnight, he turns toward the viewer with mouth open, mid-sentence, chatting cheerfully to the dark and including them in the conversation, grinning. Face: a round, sunburnt face with a peeling nose red as a radish, pink showing under the peel, broad cheeks with a freckled flush, a wide mobile mouth showing a chipped front tooth, sandy untidy bushy brows lifted, dark-ringed but cheerful eyes. Hair: brown, sticking out in tufts from under a grey knitted silk-wool cap. Body: stocky, easy, with a bouncing step, his free arm waving as he talks. Clothing: an outer warden's grey silk robe with a new, slightly too small strip of wolf fur at the collar, silver running wolves along the borders, buttoned one hole off, a grey scarf wound twice round his neck, short cuffs and boots wrapped with felt against the frost. Hands and objects: his right palm shown open, pale knobbed calluses across it, as he gestures; his left holds a wooden staff, a lantern-pole strap across his chest; a bone whistle at his chest. Power: none; a few cold motes of starlight drift by him. Background: the road running pale between black pines, a second lantern far down it at the next milestone, a small orange point, and a single cold star between the branches, in mist. Light: yellow lantern light from the upper left lighting the underside of his chin and open mouth, deep blue night behind. Expression: gregarious, open, kind.

people.imagined: The hall's yard, mid-morning. She has just sat down on a bench to mend her knee and is looking at the second grey patch on her good green silk with a mix of stubborn pride and irritation, waiting for someone to comment.
people.subject: The moment: in the hall's yard in the mid-morning, she sits on a bench with her knee held up, looking at the viewer with her chin raised, daring a remark about the second grey patch on her good green silk. Face: one small pearl earring, her father's gift, against a fine-boned oval face with a straight proud nose and a stubborn chin, smooth pale skin gone a little brown from the road, sharp, level dark eyes, fine straight brows, lips closed on an unspoken answer. Hair: glossy black, in a high neat knot with a jade-green silk ribbon and a pine twig. Body: slender, upright, a magistrate's daughter's posture. Clothing: an inner warden's long robe of fine green silk with a stand collar and two crossed collars, the knee reinforced twice with squares of grey hall silk stitched on in white thread, silver running wolves along the borders, and over it a grey half-cape with a wolf-fur strip on the left shoulder. Hands and objects: a short bow in her lap; a needle and white thread in her right hand. Power: a faint green Wood glow and a few blue Water motes brighten the thread. Background: a rack of hall bows leaning on the wall, a cat asleep on a sack, and through an open gate a caravan just coming in, in soft haze. Light: clear morning spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle glow and silver rim light. Expression: chin raised, lips closed on an unspoken answer, bright eyes daring a remark.

people.imagined: He is at the well in the hall's yard, carrying water as he did on the three nights. Someone asked him a question a moment ago and he is about to answer a different one; his mouth is half open and his eyes slightly puzzled.
people.subject: The moment: at the hall's well, two buckets on a yoke across his shoulders, he looks at the viewer a breath late, brow furrowed, about to answer a different question from the one asked. Face: big ears sticking out from the sides of his head, wide and plainly visible, a long plain face with a mild long nose, a loose open mouth with a lower lip hanging a little, wide-set trusting brown eyes, freckles, thin high eyebrows, a short wispy chin fuzz; a drop of water running down his chin. Hair: black, cropped short and sticking up over the ears. Body: tall for his age, narrow, stooped forward from years of carrying water, shoulders rounded under the yoke. Clothing: an inner warden's grey silk robe with silver running wolves along its borders, crossed collars and a clean wolf-fur half-cape on the left shoulder, a little short in the sleeve so the cuffs stop two fingers above his wrists; a bone whistle swings on its cord; plain dark grey trousers and scuffed, oiled fur boots. Hands and objects: both hands hold the rope at the yoke; two wooden buckets hang wet and shining. Power: none; a few pale motes of mist glimmer on the water. Background: an old stone well with a wooden crank and rope, the stone wet and dark, a low wall of the hall and a row of dark pines against a pale grey sky. Light: soft even spirit-light from the upper left, a faint cool shadow under his big ears, a damp shine on the buckets. Expression: honest, gentle, slow.

people.imagined: At the woodpile at the pass, she has just chopped the last log and is standing flat-footed with the axe resting; she's weighing the price of her firewood against a stranger's boots, eyes level.
people.subject: The moment: at the woodpile at the pass, she stands flat and easy with an axe resting on her shoulder, having just chopped the last log, looking steadily at the viewer and weighing the price of her firewood against a stranger's boots. Face: wood-chips plainly clinging to her brows and in her hair, pale gold against black; a square, freckled, ruddy face with a flat broad nose, wide jaw, small calm brown eyes, thick straight brows flecked with chips, a small tight mouth, wind-reddened cheeks, a small white scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, in one thick braid down her back, fine sawdust dusting the crown and braid end so the hair looks sprinkled with gold. Body: sturdy, broad-hipped, wide-shouldered, planted. Clothing: an outer warden's grey silk robe with a narrow, neatly trimmed wolf-fur strip at the collar, silver running wolves along the borders, sleeves rolled above thick freckled elbows, quilted grey silk leggings; a plain sash dusted with sap. Hands and objects: a long-handled woodcutter's axe on her shoulder; a short bow slung over the other; a pair of stranger's fur-lined boots tied to her belt by the laces. Power: a faint green Wood glow in the cut pine-faces and a few ochre Earth motes in the air. Background: a tidy wall of split pine to head height, the cut faces pale yellow, a pass of white snow beyond and a thin wisp of cloud. Light: bright cold spirit-light from the upper left with crisp shadows, the new wood glowing a warm yellow against blue-white snow. Expression: a level, unmoved look from small calm brown eyes under thick brows, the jaw set and the mouth easy, with no give in it.

people.imagined: He is lounging on a bench in the hall's yard, a size-too-fine Pivot coat open, polishing a camel bell that has never rung true. He has just copied a sum and is smiling at the page.
people.subject: The moment: lounging on a bench in the hall's yard, he looks at the viewer with a smooth easy smile, as though he has just got away with something, polishing a camel bell that has never rung true. Face: a handsome, soft round face, smooth plump cheeks, a pointed chin dimple, a small snub nose, sleepy half-lidded eyes and a smile a little too ready; neat, glossy brows, clear skin, a small beauty mark near the left corner of his mouth; no scars. Hair: glossy black, side-parted and oiled, a jade bead on a thin braid at the temple. Body: soft, plump and slouched, one leg stretched out and an arm along the back of the bench, taking up more space than he needs. Clothing: a Pivot-cut coat of fine dark-green brocade with silver-thread piping, clearly a size too large across the shoulders, hanging open over a grey outer warden's silk robe with silver running wolves, a size too small, sleeves pushed up; a pristine wolf-fur strip pinned on the collar; a pale silk scarf at his throat, and polished boots unmarked by any road. Hands and objects: in his lap a small brass camel bell, as bright and unmarked as new silver, which his thumb rubs. Power: a few golden-ochre Earth and silver Metal motes drift over the bell. Background: the plain pine-plank wall of the hall, a hook with a wolfskin hung on it, and a crate stencilled only with a painted camel, in warm haze. Light: warm golden afternoon spirit-light from the upper left warming the silver of the bell until it almost glows, with a soft shadow under his brow. Expression: lazy, charming, falsely innocent.

people.imagined: At the river road checkpoint, she is just turning her sleeve away as someone glances at it, to hide a knotted cord. She has the practised polite smile of someone who has been asked where she was born.
people.subject: The moment: at a roadside post at the river checkpoint, she has just tucked her left sleeve against her body so the knotted cord inside cannot be seen, and smiles a practised smile at the viewer, the smile of someone often asked where she was born. Face: a round, pleasant, composed face with soft plump cheeks and a small mouth, a bright false smile, while the dark eyes stay watchful and flat. Hair: dark brown, parted and tied in two buns at the nape, a green river-reed hairpin in one. Body: medium height, neat, quick, keeping her left arm folded in. Clothing: an inner warden's grey silk robe with silver running wolves along its borders, crossed collars and a wolf-fur half-cape over the left shoulder, a neat Lạc Hà river-blue silk scarf at the neck, half hidden; leather wrist guards. Hands and objects: from the edge of the left sleeve peeks a coil of blue-green knotted cord, six knots in a row; her right hand holds a staff. Power: a faint ochre Earth shimmer and a few pale green motes gather round the hidden cord. Background: a river bank with reeds and mist, a tall post with a lantern, a ferry rope slung across the river, and on the far bank a cluster of willows and a moored boat. Light: soft grey-silver morning spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle rim. Expression: composed, polite, hiding something.

people.imagined: At the village shrine of the green pines before he leaves on the road. He has just touched a seedling pine, and a resin-stained thumb is at his lips. He is promising it something in silence.
people.subject: The moment: at the village shrine of the green pines before he leaves on the road, he stands beside a small pine seedling and looks at the viewer calmly, as if finishing a silent prayer, a resin-stained thumb lately at his lips. Face: a quiet, broad-browed young face with a firm mouth, a straight nose, clear steady light-brown eyes and long dark thick lashes, brown smooth skin, a thin line of dark resin across one cheekbone, a small old scar through his chin, a tiny seed of resin dried at the corner of one eye. Hair: dark brown and short, a few green pine needles caught above his right ear, left there as if on purpose. Body: tall, sturdy and settled, weight even on both feet, shoulders loose, the calm of a man used to waiting beside things that grow. Clothing: an inner warden's grey silk robe with silver running wolves along the borders, crossed collars and a wolf-fur half-cape on the left shoulder; the sleeves plainly stained with amber pine resin, shining; at the collar one bright green pine needle sewn on with white thread; a silk sash with a bone whistle. Hands and objects: his right hand touches a foot-high pine seedling in a clay pot; a staff leans against his shoulder. Power: a gentle green aura of Wood qi stirs round the seedling and his hand, with pale green motes rising like pollen. Background: a small shrine of grey weathered boards roofed with bark, a clay incense bowl with a single curl of smoke, and a row of young pines of different heights each in a ring of stones, in mist. Light: soft green-gold spirit-light from the upper left through branches, shafts catching the resin on his sleeves like amber. Expression: a quiet, steady gaze with a firm mouth and thick lashes lowered a little, as if finishing a silent prayer.

people.imagined: The second night of 1190 on the Tùng Hạ road, before he fell: he stands at the front with a bow in the stiff hand, jaw set, lit by a wagon lantern, as the hall remembers him: the first warden.
people.subject: The moment: on the second night of 1190 on the Tùng Hạ road, before he fell, a big man stands braced at the front with a bow lowered in the stiff hand, jaw set, looking forward, as the hall remembers him: the first warden. Face: a very long lantern-jawed face, the jaw jutting like a spade, heavy brows, a straight nose, deep-set dark eyes, a short beard cut square and stippled grey, lines of old sun. Hair: black and grey, white with frost at the temples, bound in a knot with a silver-grey cloth strip. Body: huge, long-limbed, broad-chested, feet wide and weight forward in a hunter's braced stance, the huge shoulders slightly hunched against the cold and the left hand resting on his belt. Clothing: a thick grey silk robe of an inner warden with silver running wolves embroidered along the borders, a heavy full wolf mantle dark with damp and clumped at the edges, leather straps crossed on the chest, a quiver of arrows at his hip, the robe mended at the elbow; a green pine needle at the collar. Hands and objects: his right hand, stiffened from the bow, lies curled and rigid like a hook round the grip of a heavy yew bow. Power: a faint green Wood glow runs along the bow, with pale motes like pine needles. Background: beyond him a crowd of small dark shapes, the wagons drawn into a ring, their covers pale and a bell hung on the lead one, and a few red points of eyes at the edge of the trees. Light: a swinging wagon lantern casts a long gold light from the upper left across his jaw, a dead pale sky above. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: grim, loyal, resolute.
